roles.emptyMeans: A signed-up user with no role is waiting for an admin to assign one. Privacy rules give them no access to checks, defects, vehicles or checklist items, and the check, defects, fleet and history pages send them to the home page. The setup page's Remove access button clears a user's role to put them back in this state.
roles.notes: Privacy rules test 'Role is not empty', 'Role is Admin' and 'Role is not Driver'. The user's own is_demo flag separates demo accounts from real ones in several conditions.

plugins.notes: Installed, but no workflow step calls it. list_types shows one API Connector type, 'text stream'. Call definitions cannot be read with the allowed tools.

integrations.email: No custom email sending. The only email is Bubble's built-in password reset email (nav_forgot_password), which the rebuilt app's auth library replaces.

unknowns.what: The API Connector plugin is installed, but its call list and hosts cannot be read with the allowed tools. No workflow step uses an API call; list_types shows one API Connector type ('text stream').
unknowns.why: API Connector definitions are not exposed by get_node or list_types. A person should check the editor's Plugins tab to confirm whether any calls exist and what they point at.

unknowns.what: No user privacy rule lists the built-in email field in its visible or searchable fields, even the 'Admins see all users' rule that otherwise shows every field.
unknowns.why: It is unclear whether Bubble's MCP leaves email out of viewableFields, or whether email really is hidden from admins and from the user themselves. This decides who may see email addresses in the rebuild.

unknowns.what: The data sources of the vehicle dropdowns (check page 'Dropdown Choose your vehicle', history page 'Dropdown All vehicles') and the severity dropdown were not read.
unknowns.why: The reader only reads repeating group data sources. Whether off-road vehicles are hidden from drivers on the check page is therefore not known.

unknowns.what: The data source of 'Group App Settings' (which App Settings record the setup page edits) was not read.
unknowns.why: Not a repeating group, so the reader does not read it. Assumed to be the single App Settings record.

unknowns.what: Properties were not read for set-state, show, hide, reset, pause, refresh and plain navigation actions whose caption already says what they do (for example the Nav message texts, check_submit step 7, the demo_email and demo_role values for the workshop and admin demo buttons, and unconditional page changes).
unknowns.why: The reader allows skipping these. Any 'Only when' condition on those actions is therefore not recorded.
